assets.prompt:
Use case: scientific-educational
Asset type: polished future public observatory atlas illustration, landscape 3:2, preferably at least 1800 x 1200 pixels.
Primary request: Create a truly refined and believable future public observatory on a coastal hillside. The theme is mature shared capabilities enabling other people to learn, build, maintain and form their own capabilities; express this through ordinary public life and useful architecture, without symbols or text. This is speculative future imagination, not an engineering validation.
Scene/backdrop: clear deep sea blue, sunlit coast, natural rocky coastal slopes with low indigenous vegetation, distant headlands and immense open ocean; preserve a complete natural landscape. Not a green river valley, not a forest city.
Subject: a lived-in public science observatory with consistent design language: wide horizontal titanium-colored eaves, warm pale timber slats, limestone plinths, copper-colored optical rings, one recognizable blue instrument case. On the left foreground a simple open terrace with a few adults resting or discussing. In the center a precise fabrication workshop visibly inside large glass windows, with robot-assisted tools. On the right a large OPEN copper optical ring aimed toward the sea and sky, a physically supported observational instrument with real construction details, not a glowing orb. Simple accessible paths connect modest living quarters, a greenhouse, a small photovoltaic shade canopy, and a maintenance entrance. Clearly readable human scale and plausible routes. It must feel like people live and work here for years, not a resort or hotel.
Style/medium: highly finished architectural science illustration combined with believable cinematic daylight; sophisticated realistic surfaces, fine material detail, atmosphere and spatial depth; restrained, credible near-future technology.
Composition/framing: one continuous wide landscape image with no border or collage, slightly elevated viewpoint shows the WHOLE observatory in a clear real relationship to the coastal hillside and sea. Structure occupies enough of frame for workshop and people to be legible. A little quiet sky in upper left, but no excessive blank space because title is outside the image.
Lighting/mood: clear daylight outdoors, warm inhabited interiors, coastal air, quietly optimistic, serious craft and public learning.
Materials/textures: brushed titanium edges, fine pale wood grain and slats, weatherable limestone, patinated copper optical instrument hardware, clear glazing with believable reflections.
Constraints: no text, no lettering, no logos, no watermark. Natural restrained human gestures. No cartoon, no low polygon videogame rendering, no AI deity, no glowing control sphere, no cyber neon, no floating user interfaces, no grandiose futurist monument.

Use case: scientific-educational
Asset type: polished future public observatory atlas illustration, landscape 3:2, preferably at least 1800 x 1200 pixels.
Primary request: Create the interior of a refined, believable future public workshop in a coastal hillside observatory. Show mature public capabilities helping adults develop practical capabilities together, through concrete collaborative optical fabrication and maintenance. Speculative future imagination, not an engineering validation.
Scene/backdrop: warm public workshop with a clear sea-blue coastal view through a wide open glazed wall, bright sky and a large OPEN copper optical observation ring outside directed toward ocean and sky. Consistent observatory architecture: broad horizontal titanium-colored eaves visible at opening, warm pale timber slats, limestone base, copper-colored optical rings, one blue instrument case.
Subject: four or five adults of different adult ages specifically working together to inspect ONE optical device on a long deep worktable: lens housing, alignment rail and replaceable standard components are intelligible. One adult holds a blue instrument case. Others carefully adjust a small fixture, inspect a lens edge or point toward an actual mechanical connection. A small restrained robotic arm assists by holding the workpiece securely, never humanoid. Clearly recognizable orderly tool racks, interchangeable standard parts trays, and a repair bench beside them. One further adult casually drinks tea by the window. Everyday clothes, understated natural postures, believable hand interaction, humane social atmosphere. Practical technology that people can understand and repair; a place for long-term work and learning.
Style/medium: highly finished architectural scientific illustration with believable cinematic natural light, realistic sophisticated material detail and human proportions; matching a refined sunlit coastal observatory exterior. Not cartoon, not low polygon or game concept render.
Composition/framing: a single continuous landscape view at ordinary human eye level, looking from deep inside along the long table toward the open sea view and copper optical ring; people and the optical task are substantial and clearly visible, interior depth and outdoors integrated naturally.
Lighting/mood: soft afternoon daylight, warm wood interior, calm advanced rigorous busy public life, clear ocean blues balanced with warm pale timber and copper.
Materials/textures: finely grained warm pale timber, titanium fixture details, brushed copper optical hardware, limestone base, clear glass, credible worn working surfaces.
Constraints: no text, lettering, logos, watermark, borders or collage. No AI deity, no glowing control sphere, no cyber neon, no floating interfaces, no theatrical gesturing or futuristic costumes.
